rulesets.scope: Empty visible public listing; response headers, hidden policies and reviewer permissions not inspected

mainProtection.scope: Unauthenticated read refused; not evidence that detailed protection settings are absent

limits: This recheck lists branches and workflows only; it does not refresh the earlier commit-pinned root listing or retained-run inventory.
Zero registered workflows does not prove that no workflow ever ran or that no older history was deleted.
The branch protected flag is not a detailed ruleset, organization-policy, required-check or reviewer-permission audit.
An empty public ruleset listing and a 401 protection read do not establish all effective policies; no authenticated fallback or permission escalation was attempted.
The separate MCP responses are neither an atomic snapshot nor a pre-read byte-bounded transport.
Remote main differs from local HEAD; no ancestry, synchronization or source import is inferred.
assessment: Hosted enforcement is not established. The workflow and runner remain local untracked source; publication, settings changes and eligible human review retain their separate approval gates.
